**Figures entered (EUR):**

| Office | October | November | December |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dublin | 84,200 | 91,750 | 103,400 |
| Hamburg | 156,320 | 162,870 | 171,540 |
| Lisbon | 71,180 | 69,850 | 82,410 |
| Rotterdam | 128,940 | 133,260 | 139,780 |
| Stockholm | 186,240 | 179,650 | 201,930 |
| Vienna | 112,400 | 118,900 | 131,200 |

- **Q4 total for each office (column E):** `=SUM(B5:D5)` and so on down the rows. Dublin 279,350, Hamburg 490,730, Lisbon 223,440, Rotterdam 401,980, Stockholm 567,820, Vienna 362,500.

- **Average revenue per office and month:** `=AVERAGE(B5:D10)` = 129,212
- **Growth from October to December, all offices:** `=D11/B11-1` = 12.3%

- **Lisbon November:** I used the final figure (69,850), not the 2 December draft (74,600). The draft had wrongly counted a €4,750 December invoice in November.
- **Vienna:** its report gives figures in thousands of euros, so 112.4 / 118.9 / 131.2 became 112,400 / 118,900 / 131,200.
- **Stockholm:** October to December are on page 2 of its table.
